dialogues.jp:
気が付けば、昼休みも後少しで終わろうとして
いた。
dialogues.en: I realize the lunch break is almost over.
dialogues.text: I realize the lunch break is almost over.

dialogues.jp:
喧騒の広がる廊下に帰ってきて、お互いに顔を
見合わせてしまう。
dialogues.en:
We all look at each other when we find the clamor in the
hallway.
dialogues.text:
We all look at each other when we find the clamor in the
hallway.

dialogues.jp: 「巻き込んですまないなふたりとも」
dialogues.en: "Sorry I brought you into this chaos."
dialogues.text: "Sorry I brought you into this chaos."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「あ、いいよぉ。そもそも朝倉君のせいじゃな
　いし、私だって芳乃さんのこと心配だもん」
dialogues.en:
"Don't worry about it. It's not your fault, and I'm worried
about Yoshino-san as well."
dialogues.text:
"Don't worry about it. It's not your fault, and I'm worried
about Yoshino-san as well."

dialogues.jp: 忠誠度ＭＡＸの微笑み。
dialogues.en: She smiles to show her 100% loyalty.
dialogues.text: She smiles to show her 100% loyalty.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ランチのためだ」
dialogues.en: "It's for the sake of lunch."
dialogues.text: "It's for the sake of lunch."

dialogues.jp: 忠誠度２７の呟きだった。
dialogues.en: He mutters, showing his 27% loyalty.
dialogues.text: He mutters, showing his 27% loyalty.

dialogues.jp:
「……杉並、買収されそうになったら、こちら
　はランチにデザートをつけることを約束して
　おこう」
dialogues.en:
"When you get bought out by her, I promise you will have the
dessert after lunch."
dialogues.text:
"When you get bought out by her, I promise you will have the
dessert after lunch."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「今、このミッションは俺の中でも最重要ラン
　クに登録されたぞ」
dialogues.en:
"This mission is ranked at the top in my high-priority
issues."
dialogues.text:
"This mission is ranked at the top in my high-priority
issues."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「……極端に信用のおける分かりやすさで助か
　るよ」
dialogues.en: "I appreciate it is very easy for me to understand."
dialogues.text: "I appreciate it is very easy for me to understand."

dialogues.jp:
経費という概念が通用するのかとか考えながら、
ふと、さくらの様子が気にかかった。
dialogues.en:
I worry about Sakura as I wonder if he understands what the
budget is.
dialogues.text:
I worry about Sakura as I wonder if he understands what the
budget is.

dialogues.jp:
「あのさ、ちょっと調子が悪くなったんで午後
　の授業は休むわ」
dialogues.en:
"Hey, I don't feel good, so I'll skip the class in the
afternoon."
dialogues.text:
"Hey, I don't feel good, so I'll skip the class in the
afternoon."

dialogues.jp:
しゅた、と手を掲げて、教室に戻ろうとする波
に逆らって歩き出す。
dialogues.en:
Putting my hands up, I walk against the crowd heading for
the classroom.
dialogues.text:
Putting my hands up, I walk against the crowd heading for
the classroom.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「え、朝倉君どこの具合が悪いの？」
dialogues.en: "What's wrong with you, Asakura-kun?"
dialogues.text: "What's wrong with you, Asakura-kun?"

dialogues.jp: 首だけ振り返って、少しだけ考えてみる。
dialogues.en:
Turning around only my head, I think about that for a
moment.
dialogues.text:
Turning around only my head, I think about that for a
moment.

dialogues.jp:
「……頭が悪くなったって講師に言っておいて
　くれ」
dialogues.en: "Can you tell my teacher I have a bad brain?"
dialogues.text: "Can you tell my teacher I have a bad brain?"

dialogues.jp:
「職員室か……まさか自分からココに入ろうと
　思うなんて、本当にどうかしてるな」
dialogues.en: "It's the staff room... I can't believe I'm going inside."
dialogues.text: "It's the staff room... I can't believe I'm going inside."

dialogues.jp:
辺りを見渡して人がいないことを確認してから、
頭を抱えてしまう。
dialogues.en:
I hold my head in my hands after making sure nobody is
around me.
dialogues.text:
I hold my head in my hands after making sure nobody is
around me.

dialogues.jp:
わざわざ予鈴が鳴って、中の講師が授業でいな
くなるまで隠れていたのだ。
dialogues.en:
I was hiding until the bell rang and all teachers left for
their classes.
dialogues.text:
I was hiding until the bell rang and all teachers left for
their classes.

dialogues.jp:
あんなことの後ではさくらに授業はないと踏ん
でいたが、予想通り、外に出た講師の中にあい
つの姿はなかった。
dialogues.en:
I doubted that Sakura could teach the class any more after
the rumor went out. As I expected, I didn't see her among
the teachers who came outside.
dialogues.text:
I doubted that Sakura could teach the class any more after
the rumor went out. As I expected, I didn't see her among
the teachers who came outside.

dialogues.jp: 「よし」
dialogues.en: "Okay, now."
dialogues.text: "Okay, now."

dialogues.jp: 勢い宜しく扉にノックをしようと――。
dialogues.en: Let's knock on the door......
dialogues.text: Let's knock on the door......

dialogues.speaker: Female teacher
dialogues.jp: 「あら？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
ノックの予備動作の途中で、なにかの紋章でも
見せるみたいに、手の甲を掲げた姿で女性の講
師に見つかった。
dialogues.en:
As I was preparing to knock, a female teacher saw me raising
my hand as if I'm showing a police badge or something.
dialogues.text:
As I was preparing to knock, a female teacher saw me raising
my hand as if I'm showing a police badge or something.

dialogues.jp:
変身ヒーローなんですとか、言い逃れ出来ない
ものだろうか。
dialogues.en:
I may be able to escape from this situation if I say I'm a
hero transforming.
dialogues.text:
I may be able to escape from this situation if I say I'm a
hero transforming.

dialogues.speaker: Female teacher
dialogues.jp: 「こら、もう授業ははじまってるぞ」
dialogues.en: "C'mon, the class is starting."
dialogues.text: "C'mon, the class is starting."

dialogues.jp:
当たり前だが、ノックの予備動作に見えたらし
い。
dialogues.en:
It's obvious, but she could tell it was a preparatory action
for a knock.
dialogues.text:
It's obvious, but she could tell it was a preparatory action
for a knock.

dialogues.jp:
「ちょっと呼び出されていまして、さくら……
　あ、芳乃先生はいますか？」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I was called in... Is Sakura, I mean, Yoshino-sensei
here?"
dialogues.text:
"Well, I was called in... Is Sakura, I mean, Yoshino-sensei
here?"

dialogues.speaker: Female teacher
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ええ、なんの用事？」
dialogues.en: "Uhh, yes. What do you want?"
dialogues.text: "Uhh, yes. What do you want?"

dialogues.jp: さすがに職員室ともなるとガードが固い。
dialogues.en:
As I expected, the guard for a faculty office is very
serious.
dialogues.text:
As I expected, the guard for a faculty office is very
serious.

dialogues.jp:
「ちょっと先の事件の関係者でして、白河先生
　にすぐに謝ってこいと言われまして」
dialogues.en:
"I was involved in the incident from the other day, and
Koyomi-sensei sent me here to apologize."
dialogues.text:
"I was involved in the incident from the other day, and
Koyomi-sensei sent me here to apologize."

dialogues.speaker: Female teacher
dialogues.jp: 「ふーん……そぅ。中にいるわよ」
dialogues.en: "Hmmm... I see. She's in there."
dialogues.text: "Hmmm... I see. She's in there."

dialogues.jp:
途端に興味をなくしたのか、視線を泳がせてか
ら彼女は身体をずらして｛さっそう／颯爽｝と横を通り抜けて
いった。
dialogues.en: She seems to quickly lose interest in me, and walks past me.
dialogues.text: She seems to quickly lose interest in me, and walks past me.

dialogues.en: "Whew..."
dialogues.text: "Whew..."

dialogues.jp:
溜めすぎた息を吐き出して、よぼよぼ、と未知
の扉をくぐった。
dialogues.en:
I release the breath I've been holding for a long time, and
walk through the door into the unknown.
dialogues.text:
I release the breath I've been holding for a long time, and
walk through the door into the unknown.

dialogues.jp: 誰もいない、驚くほど静かな職員室。
dialogues.en: The staff room is surprisingly quiet and almost deserted.
dialogues.text: The staff room is surprisingly quiet and almost deserted.

dialogues.jp:
窓際の、教材も私物も必要最低限しかおいてい
ない机に肘をついて、さくらが眠っている。
dialogues.en:
I see Sakura dozing off, resting her elbow on a desk that
has a few of her books and things on it.
dialogues.text:
I see Sakura dozing off, resting her elbow on a desk that
has a few of her books and things on it.

dialogues.jp:
窓から吹き込む風に金色の髪が細かく波打つ。
その一本一本が、光を照り返して中空に複雑な
軌跡を生んだ。
dialogues.en:
The wind blowing through the window ruffles her blonde hair.
Each hair makes an intricate trace in the air, reflecting
the light.
dialogues.text:
The wind blowing through the window ruffles her blonde hair.
Each hair makes an intricate trace in the air, reflecting
the light.

dialogues.jp:
なんとなく……なんとなく、秋のススキ野原が
連想される。
dialogues.en: Somehow, it reminds of pampas grass in autumn.
dialogues.text: Somehow, it reminds of pampas grass in autumn.

dialogues.jp:
息さえしていなければ、人形と言われても信じ
たかも知れない。
dialogues.en: If she wasn't breathing, she could look like a doll.
dialogues.text: If she wasn't breathing, she could look like a doll.

dialogues.jp: 軽い身じろぎにうなじが露わになる。
dialogues.en: When she moves, the nape of her neck shows.
dialogues.text: When she moves, the nape of her neck shows.

dialogues.jp: 「……あ、おぃ、さくら」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Sakura."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Sakura."

dialogues.jp: まずいまずい、一瞬、見とれてしまった。
dialogues.en: Good heaven, I'm enchanted with her.
dialogues.text: Good heaven, I'm enchanted with her.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Mmmm... oohh... no..."
dialogues.text: "Mmmm... oohh... no..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「さくら……っ？」
dialogues.en: "Sakura!"
dialogues.text: "Sakura!"

dialogues.jp:
軽くゆすろうと肩に手をかけると、ビッ、と指
が電気でも流れたみたいに｛しび／痺｝れた。
dialogues.en:
When I put my hand on her shoulder, my fingers become numb
as if I was electrocuted.
dialogues.text:
When I put my hand on her shoulder, my fingers become numb
as if I was electrocuted.

dialogues.jp: 自分の指を見つめる。
dialogues.en: I look at my fingers.
dialogues.text: I look at my fingers.

dialogues.jp:
そういえば、今まで自分からは頭とか、猫みた
いに首の裏しか触れなかったが、さくらの肩が
あんまりにも｛きゃしゃ／華奢｝で驚いた。
dialogues.en:
I've touched her head before, or the back of her neck like a
cat, but this is the first time I've touched her shoulder.
To my surprise, it's very thin.
dialogues.text:
I've touched her head before, or the back of her neck like a
cat, but this is the first time I've touched her shoulder.
To my surprise, it's very thin.

dialogues.jp: 手とか繋いでても子供みたいに小さいし……。
dialogues.en: I know her hand is so small, like a child's.
dialogues.text: I know her hand is so small, like a child's.

dialogues.jp:
でも、意外なことだが、さくらのその柔らかさ
は女の子なんだ。
dialogues.en: But she is still a girl to have such a soft touch.
dialogues.text: But she is still a girl to have such a soft touch.

dialogues.jp:
「……って！　いや、さっきからなにバカなこ
　とを考えてるんだ俺は！？」
dialogues.en: "What the heck am I thinking about?"
dialogues.text: "What the heck am I thinking about?"

dialogues.jp: 口元を押さえて天井を見上げる。
dialogues.en: I look up the ceiling covering my mouth.
dialogues.text: I look up the ceiling covering my mouth.

dialogues.jp:
暦先生の話を聞いて、なんとなく感傷的になっ
ているのかも知れない。
dialogues.en: I may be sentimental after Koyomi-sensei's story.
dialogues.text: I may be sentimental after Koyomi-sensei's story.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ぅぅ……お兄ちゃん……」
dialogues.en: "Mmmm... oniichan..."
dialogues.text: "Mmmm... oniichan..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あ、だから、おいって」
dialogues.en: "Oh, hey, you."
dialogues.text: "Oh, hey, you."

dialogues.jp:
もはや自分がなんのために来たのかも忘れたが、
うなされているさくらを放ってはおけない。
dialogues.en:
I already forgot why I was here, but I can't leave her
having a nightmare.
dialogues.text:
I already forgot why I was here, but I can't leave her
having a nightmare.

dialogues.jp:
てっきり、講師になったさくらに問題などない
と思っていた。
dialogues.en:
I completely believed there was no problem with Sakura being
a teacher.
dialogues.text:
I completely believed there was no problem with Sakura being
a teacher.

dialogues.jp:
だが、それこそ夢のテレビドラマのような問題
を抱えていたのだ。こいつは。
dialogues.en:
But it turns out she's having a kind of trouble I'd expect
to see in a TV drama.
dialogues.text:
But it turns out she's having a kind of trouble I'd expect
to see in a TV drama.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃんダメ……ね……か……ねこ……」
dialogues.en: "No, oniichan... Ca...ca...cat..."
dialogues.text: "No, oniichan... Ca...ca...cat..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ねこ？」
dialogues.en: "Cat?"
dialogues.text: "Cat?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「猫缶♪」
dialogues.en: "Cat food."
dialogues.text: "Cat food."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「起きろや！」
dialogues.en: "Wake up now!"
dialogues.text: "Wake up now!"

dialogues.jp: 頭をはたく。
dialogues.en: I tap her head.
dialogues.text: I tap her head.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ……」
ぐずぐず、と唇を揺らしてさくらが目を開く。
dialogues.en: Sakura opens her eyes, moving her lips slowly.
dialogues.text: Sakura opens her eyes, moving her lips slowly.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あ、お兄ちゃん♪　おはよー♪」
dialogues.en: "Oh, oniichan! Good morning!"
dialogues.text: "Oh, oniichan! Good morning!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うなされてたんじゃないのか？」
dialogues.en: "Were you having a nightmare?"
dialogues.text: "Were you having a nightmare?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あ、そうそう。うたまるが猫缶を独り占めし
　て逃げようとするけど、お兄ちゃんと一緒に
　なんとか奪い返したんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, listen. Utamaru tried to run away with all the cat
food, but you and I grabbed it back."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, listen. Utamaru tried to run away with all the cat
food, but you and I grabbed it back."

dialogues.jp: あぁ、こいつ、口を開いたらもうダメだ。
dialogues.en: Oh, she looks better when she's not talking.
dialogues.text: Oh, she looks better when she's not talking.

dialogues.jp:
「さっきのチョーク投げの件で、落ち込んでた
　んじゃないんだな？」
dialogues.en:
"Were you depressed about the incident when you threw the
chalk?"
dialogues.text:
"Were you depressed about the incident when you threw the
chalk?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「もちろん怒られたけど、そんなに気にしてな
　いよ」
dialogues.en: "I'm sure they're angry at me, but I don't care much."
dialogues.text: "I'm sure they're angry at me, but I don't care much."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……無理してないか？」
dialogues.en: "Don't push yourself too hard."
dialogues.text: "Don't push yourself too hard."

dialogues.jp:
隣の机によりかかって、なんだか安堵の息をも
らす。
dialogues.en:
I give a sigh of relief, leaning against the desk next to
her.
dialogues.text:
I give a sigh of relief, leaning against the desk next to
her.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「してないよ〜。だって……にゃははは♪」
dialogues.en: "I don't. Because... Nyahahahaha!"
dialogues.text: "I don't. Because... Nyahahahaha!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……ついに壊れたか？」
dialogues.en: "Have you finally lost it?"
dialogues.text: "Have you finally lost it?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「いや、それがあのね、田端くんがクスクスっ
　て笑うんだよ。面白かったって。嬉しいねぇ」
dialogues.en:
"Well, listen. Tabata-kun chuckled and told me it was
funny."
dialogues.text:
"Well, listen. Tabata-kun chuckled and told me it was
funny."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「へぇ……あの一言男がか」
dialogues.en: "Really... The one-word man said that?"
dialogues.text: "Really... The one-word man said that?"

dialogues.jp:
あいつが笑うところなんて、見たことあっただ
ろうか。
dialogues.en: I've never seen him chuckling.
dialogues.text: I've never seen him chuckling.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ、一言男？」
dialogues.en: "Hmm... The one-word man?"
dialogues.text: "Hmm... The one-word man?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あぁ。なぜか１日に１回しか喋らないんだ。
　授業中でもだから、あれは徹底してるな」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah. He speaks only one word a day. Even in class, he
sticks to that rule."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah. He speaks only one word a day. Even in class, he
sticks to that rule."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ふ〜ん……なんでだろう？」
dialogues.en: "Hmm... Why's that?"
dialogues.text: "Hmm... Why's that?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なんで？」
dialogues.en: "Why?"
dialogues.text: "Why?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うん。そういうのは理由があると思うんだよ。
　やっぱりお話してるほうがちゃんと思いは伝
　わるし、楽しいでしょ？　なのにね」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah. He must have a reason to do it. I like to talk,
otherwise I don't know what you want... and it's just more
fun. Right?"
dialogues.text:
"Yeah. He must have a reason to do it. I like to talk,
otherwise I don't know what you want... and it's just more
fun. Right?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「まぁ、な」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「願掛けみたいなものかな？」
dialogues.en: "He might have made a vow."
dialogues.text: "He might have made a vow."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「願掛け？」
dialogues.en: "Made a vow?"
dialogues.text: "Made a vow?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うん。自分がなにかする代わりに、こういう
　願いを叶えてくださいって、神さまにお願い
　するの」
dialogues.en:
"Yep. You ask God for something you wish, and in return you
make a promise."
dialogues.text:
"Yep. You ask God for something you wish, and in return you
make a promise."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ボクも願掛けしたんだよ。お兄ちゃんと会え
　ますようにって」
dialogues.en: "I made a vow before. I wished for our reunion."
dialogues.text: "I made a vow before. I wished for our reunion."

dialogues.jp: 小さく、頬を赤らめてさくらが笑う。
dialogues.en: Sakura smiles while blushing.
dialogues.text: Sakura smiles while blushing.

dialogues.jp:
ふと思えば、春の午後、授業中になんでこんな
ところで話をしているのか。
dialogues.en:
I briefly wonder why we're here on a spring afternoon,
talking about this in the middle of class.
dialogues.text:
I briefly wonder why we're here on a spring afternoon,
talking about this in the middle of class.

dialogues.jp: 窓から吹き込む風が気持ちいい。
dialogues.en: The breeze blowing through the window feels so good.
dialogues.text: The breeze blowing through the window feels so good.

dialogues.jp:
「なぁ、お前ってどうして先生になろうと思っ
　たんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Why did you want to become a teacher?"
dialogues.text: "Why did you want to become a teacher?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「Ｗｈａｔ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「先生だよ。お前が先生になりたかったのにも、
　やっぱり、なんか理由があるんだろ？」
dialogues.en:
"Being a teacher. You must have a reason why you wanted to
be a teacher."
dialogues.text:
"Being a teacher. You must have a reason why you wanted to
be a teacher."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ほぇ」
dialogues.en: "Huhh..."
dialogues.text: "Huhh..."

dialogues.jp:
窓の外に――目を逸らすには絶好の景色に向かっ
て、さくらが首をかしげる。
dialogues.en:
Sakura tilts her head away from the most beautiful view
outside the window.
dialogues.text:
Sakura tilts her head away from the most beautiful view
outside the window.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「忘れちった」
dialogues.en: "I forgot."
dialogues.text: "I forgot."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……そうか」
dialogues.en: "Really."
dialogues.text: "Really."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp: なるほど。
dialogues.en: I see.
dialogues.text: I see.

dialogues.jp:
なにかを隠しているってのは、意外と気づくも
のだ。
dialogues.en: I can tell when she hides something from me.
dialogues.text: I can tell when she hides something from me.

dialogues.jp:
そして、まぁ、気づけるけれども完全に聞き出
すのも難しい。
dialogues.en: Well, I can tell, but it's not easy to find out what it is.
dialogues.text: Well, I can tell, but it's not easy to find out what it is.

dialogues.jp: 「なぁ、さくら」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Sakura."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Sakura."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「んにゃ？」
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……いや、なんでもない」
dialogues.en: "...No, it's nothing."
dialogues.text: "...No, it's nothing."

dialogues.jp: 机から離れて職員室を出ようと思った。
dialogues.en:
I think I should walk away from her desk and get out of the
staff room.
dialogues.text:
I think I should walk away from her desk and get out of the
staff room.

dialogues.jp:
こいつが人に危害を加えているなんて、絶対に
ありえない。
dialogues.en: I don't believe she's causing harm to others.
dialogues.text: I don't believe she's causing harm to others.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「授業行きなよ」
dialogues.en: "You should go back to class."
dialogues.text: "You should go back to class."

dialogues.jp: 背中に声がかかる。
dialogues.en: I hear her voice from behind me.
dialogues.text: I hear her voice from behind me.

dialogues.jp:
「……面倒くさいなぁ〜。この際、屋上か中庭
　で昼寝でもしようとか考えてたんだけど」
dialogues.en:
"What a pain in the neck. I wish I could take a nap on the
rooftop or a courtyard."
dialogues.text:
"What a pain in the neck. I wish I could take a nap on the
rooftop or a courtyard."

dialogues.jp: 職員室の扉に寄りかかって肩をすくめる。
dialogues.en: I lean against the staff room door and shrug my shoulders.
dialogues.text: I lean against the staff room door and shrug my shoulders.

dialogues.jp: 「さくら先生に見つかってるからな」
dialogues.en: "Sakura-sensei saw me here."
dialogues.text: "Sakura-sensei saw me here."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Yep."
dialogues.text: "Yep."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「がんばれよ」
dialogues.en: "Hang in there."
dialogues.text: "Hang in there."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「…………あ……うん……あの、お兄ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "Uhh... yeah... hey, oniichan."
dialogues.text: "Uhh... yeah... hey, oniichan."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ……っ！？」
dialogues.en: "What is it?"
dialogues.text: "What is it?"

dialogues.jp:
振り返った瞬間に、どん、と胸に重たいモノが
ぶつかる。
dialogues.en: When I turn around, something heavy hits my chest.
dialogues.text: When I turn around, something heavy hits my chest.

dialogues.jp:
廊下の窓際まで押されていて、いったいなにか
と思ったらさくらだった。
dialogues.en:
I get pushed against the windowsill in the hallway. I have
no idea what it is until I find out it's Sakura.
dialogues.text:
I get pushed against the windowsill in the hallway. I have
no idea what it is until I find out it's Sakura.

dialogues.en: "Sakura?"
dialogues.text: "Sakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……充電中」
dialogues.en: "I'm charging."
dialogues.text: "I'm charging."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なにがあった？」
dialogues.en: "What happened?"
dialogues.text: "What happened?"

dialogues.jp: ぎゅっ、と頭を抱きしめる。
dialogues.en: I hold her head tight.
dialogues.text: I hold her head tight.

dialogues.jp:
さくらは無言で首を横に動かそうとした……感
触が腕に伝わった。
dialogues.en:
Sakura tries to turn her neck to the side, and I feel it on
my arms.
dialogues.text:
Sakura tries to turn her neck to the side, and I feel it on
my arms.

dialogues.jp:
そのまま、ずるずると壁に座り込んで、さくら
をしっかりと抱きしめる。
dialogues.en:
I squat down, sliding along the wall, and hold Sakura in my
arms.
dialogues.text:
I squat down, sliding along the wall, and hold Sakura in my
arms.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……電池が切れちゃったんだよ」
dialogues.en: "I think the battery ran out."
dialogues.text: "I think the battery ran out."

dialogues.jp:
静かな廊下に、さくらの呟きがガラスが砕ける
みたいに響き渡った。
dialogues.en:
Sakura's mumbling echoes in the quiet hallway as if it could
crack the window.
dialogues.text:
Sakura's mumbling echoes in the quiet hallway as if it could
crack the window.

dialogues.jp:
俺の膝で猫のように丸まる背と、日向と桜の匂
いのする髪をなでながら頷く。
dialogues.en:
I nod as I stroke her hair, scented with the sunshine and
cherry blossoms, and her back, curling up like a cat on my
lap.
dialogues.text:
I nod as I stroke her hair, scented with the sunshine and
cherry blossoms, and her back, curling up like a cat on my
lap.

dialogues.jp:
こんなところを目撃されれば、それこそさくら
や俺の立場がないってのに。
dialogues.en: If somebody sees this, we are going to be in big trouble.
dialogues.text: If somebody sees this, we are going to be in big trouble.

dialogues.jp: それでもいいと――思う俺がいた。
dialogues.en: But I don't care...
dialogues.text: But I don't care...

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「充電中」
dialogues.en: "I'm charging."
dialogues.text: "I'm charging."

dialogues.jp:
そっと小さな手が、胸に触れ、首に触れ、頬に
触れた。
dialogues.en: Her little hand touches my chest, my neck and my cheeks.
dialogues.text: Her little hand touches my chest, my neck and my cheeks.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「充電中」
dialogues.en: "I'm charging."
dialogues.text: "I'm charging."

dialogues.jp: そっと小さな唇が――。
dialogues.en: Her tiny lips...
dialogues.text: Her tiny lips...

dialogues.jp: 柔らかかった。
dialogues.en: They're soft.
dialogues.text: They're soft.

dialogues.jp: ◆さくら先生・充電中◆
dialogues.en: ◆Sakura-sensei is charging◆
dialogues.text: ◆Sakura-sensei is charging◆

dialogues.jp:
無償とちょっとした有償で手伝ってくれる、杉
並とことりに感謝しつつ、ちょっとひとりで職
員室を覗きに行く。
dialogues.en:
I go to the staff room by myself, thanking Suginami and
Kotori for their help with a free lunch and a little reward.
dialogues.text:
I go to the staff room by myself, thanking Suginami and
Kotori for their help with a free lunch and a little reward.

dialogues.jp:
案の定、心の中で落ち込んでいたさくらに泣
きつかれてしまい、思わずキスをしてしまっ
た……。
dialogues.en:
As I expected, Sakura, who had been feeling down, started to
cry, and then I found myself kissing her.
dialogues.text:
As I expected, Sakura, who had been feeling down, started to
cry, and then I found myself kissing her.
